name: Bangladesh Post postcode booklet — Dhaka Division post offices (scan on post.rajshahi.gov.bd)
organization: বাংলাদেশ ডাক বিভাগ (Bangladesh Post Office) — DPMG Rajshahi Division portal
attribution: বাংলাদেশ ডাক বিভাগ (Bangladesh Post Office) — DPMG Rajshahi Division portal
notes: Same undated scanned booklet as the Rajshahi and Rangpur runs (page last updated 2018-09-21; no text layer). Dhaka Division's offices are in the booklet's 'ঢাকা রিজিয়ন ১০০০-২৯৯৯' (p. 9 Dhaka city, Dhaka district, Narayanganj; pp. 10-11 Narayanganj, Munshiganj, Narsingdi, Gazipur, Manikganj, Tangail; pp. 12-13 Tangail, Kishoreganj) and, for the Faridpur group, in 'খুলনা রিজিয়ন' (pp. 24-25: Rajbari, Faridpur, Madaripur, Shariatpur, Gopalganj); only these districts were transcribed, by hand, from the page images (raw/*.png, PDF pages 6, 7, 8 and 14 rotated). fetch.py verifies the PDF hash and re-emits the transcription. Three postcodes are not legible in the scan and are left empty. Branch post offices are not in the booklet.
